description: Empirical evaluation, benchmark, or research reproduction

description: Runnable user-facing example, recipe, or reference deployment

name: status: needs-triage
description: Needs an initial maintainer decision and routing

name: status: needs-reproduction
description: Needs a minimal reproduction or independent confirmation

name: status: waiting-author
description: Cannot progress until the author supplies requested information

name: status: confirmed
description: Maintainers reproduced or otherwise validated the reported problem

name: status: ready
description: Scope is agreed and the issue is ready for implementation

name: status: blocked
description: Cannot progress until an external decision or dependency is resolved

name: status: keep-open
description: Exempt from automated stale handling

name: ci: gpu-required
description: Needs validation in a supported accelerator environment before merge

name: priority: p0
description: Active incident, severe regression, or release-blocking problem

name: priority: p1
description: High-impact work that maintainers intend to prioritize

name: priority: p2
description: Normal-priority accepted work

name: priority: p3
description: Useful backlog work without a current delivery commitment

name: good first issue
description: Small, well-scoped work suitable for a first contribution

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome an external contributor to request assignment

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked by another issue or pull request

name: invalid
description: Does not contain a valid or actionable report

name: wontfix
description: Not planned because of scope, direction, or maintenance cost

name: KIV
description: Keep in view; deferred pending a clearer need

name: stale
description: Inactive and awaiting confirmation that the work remains relevant
